english.note: Use 得 for a short, casual sense of being able, allowed, or feasible, especially in 得唔得 questions.

exampleSentences.english: Can we do it this way?

english.note: Use 得 when saying that something is sufficient, works, or is acceptable, as in 得喇 or 咁樣得唔得.
